title: Pinball M
reason: Pinball M fails to qualify for Gamegata because it is fundamentally a sports/arcade game with only superficial horror aesthetics. The 'horror-inspired' tables are merely cosmetic themes applied to standard pinball mechanics - there's no survival element, no psychological terror, no atmospheric dread, and no genuine scares beyond occasional visual gore on the table designs. The gameplay loop remains entirely that of a casual sports arcade game: score points, complete objectives, tilt management. Any horror elements are reduced to thematic skinning rather than meaningful horror design. It represents the type of 'horror tag' abuse we're filtering out - games that use horror aesthetics as flavor text while delivering zero actual horror experience.
